brief:
A surge in Israeli settler attacks against Palestinians has prompted questions about potential European Union action, according to Al Jazeera English. The escalation reflects intensifying tensions in areas where Israeli settlements are located, with Palestinians experiencing an uptick in violent incidents from settlers in recent periods.

The EU has not yet announced specific measures in response to the violence. EU member states have historically expressed concerns over settlement expansion and related security incidents, though unified action has often proved difficult to coordinate among the bloc's 27 nations. Past responses to similar developments have ranged from diplomatic statements to discussions of targeted measures, reflecting divergent positions among member governments on how to address Israeli settlement policy.
dek: Surge in Israeli settler attacks against Palestinians.
title: EU weighs response to surge in settler violence against Palestinians.
